pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit high-frequency edge angularity with irregular, non-linear pixel gradients. Shapes are predominantly complex polygons with significant variation in relative spatial area across the flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are distinct, with pathways maintaining a relatively consistent pixel thickness of approximately 5-10 pixels at the current resolution.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a fine-grained, jagged silhouette with low-amplitude vertical protrusions against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, localized dark silhouette is perched on the posterior dorsal ridge, creating a distinct discontinuity in the smooth structural line of the back.
